observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a PS5 physical game case with a yellow cover.
The cover reads "PS5" at the top, "MARVEL WOLVERINE" in large text, "INSOMNIAC" near the bottom, and the PlayStation logo at bottom right.
A watermark "TAMMY WILLIAMS" runs across the center of the image.
A game controller is partially visible in the background at lower right.

risks.risk: The case may be empty or the disc may be missing, scratched, or unreadable.
risks.proof: A photo of the case opened with the disc visible and the disc label readable.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty case with no playable disc

risks.risk: The case may be a counterfeit or pirate reproduction rather than an authentic retail copy.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the spine, back cover, barcode, disc, and any manual for comparison with an authentic retail copy.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-authentic or reproduction copy

proof_requests: Open the case and show the disc inside with the label readable.
Show the spine, back cover, and barcode clearly.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable from the cover as a physical PS5 copy of Marvel's Wolverine, so it can be priced at its worst case (case with no proven working disc) without needing another shot.
